issue.title: Generic gate-input UX: TypedInputForm bool toggle and Telegram step-flow yes/no and Keep default buttons

task_type_fields.proposal:
Generic gate-input UX for custom gates, off the Plan Decision path:
- ACE TypedInputForm: render boolean inputs as a toggle instead of a text field.
- Telegram's step-flow typed-input prompts: a yes/no keyboard for boolean fields, plus a "Keep default: X" button for any field with a default.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Plan Decisions compile to raw schema properties collected by dedicated panels (research C1), so these generic-input fixes are no longer on the decision path. sase-1hi plan section 5.9 split them out deliberately. Proposed by sase-1hi.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #5).

issue.creation_reason: Plan Decisions bypassed generic gate inputs, leaving the planned bool-toggle and keep-default improvements for custom gates unowned.
